published_source: Figure 3 of the article is graphical (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2025.00954.txt). published_coef (Nov 2 audit) = equal-weight average of the authors' t0..t7 coefficients in Figure2and3.log, in the authors' normalization (reference rel = -7); no SE (covariances not logged). fixest reproduces the log. Nov 2 summary rule (team-lead: summaries average every reported bin, endpoint bins included): published_coef is now the equal-weight average of weeks 0..7 and the aggregated 8 category (all plotted in Figure 3) in the authors' normalization, 0.08641252 (delta-method SE 0.058445, cluster user); the previous value 0.08640813 is kept in published_coef_0_7. Pre-summary average 0.008009186.

authors_code.source: Figure 2and3.do / Figure2and3.log; fixest reproduces all 16 coefficients and N exactly
authors_code.reference_period: relative week -7 omitted (t_7 not in the regression); t_dummy = rel <= -8, tdummy = rel >= 8

event_structure.source: Figure 2and3.do (reghdfe dineout t_dummy t_6..t_1 t0..t7 tdummy + 7 controls, absorb(week newid) vce(cluster newid)): t_dummy = sum of t_8..t_56 (rel <= -8), tdummy = sum of t8..t26 (rel >= 8), t_7 omitted (article Section 4: periods beyond two months aggregated into before/after categories; earliest unaggregated week t = -7 is the baseline). Authors' rel = week - first subscription week; g_week = week - rel (constant within user), weeks 1-57 consecutive and balanced, so rel = t - g in the pipeline index. Treated rel spans -56..26: every treated row is in a bin or the reference (nothing uncovered). Endpoint bins (<= -8, >= 8) are estimated but excluded from the summaries; pre summary = the six reported leads -6..-1 (reference -7).
event_structure.verified: fixest with these bins + the 7 controls on the authors' sample (Figure2and3_dataset, N = 123,234, 2,162 users) reproduces all 16 coefficients in Figure2and3.log, max abs diff 4.5e-08 (log rounding); post average (0..7, ref -7) = 0.08640813 Nov 2 summary rule: with the reported endpoint bins added to the summaries, the authors'-normalization post average is 0.08641252 (SE 0.058445) and the pre average 0.008009186 (scratchpad/meta3/rule2/).
event_structure.summary_rule: Nov 2 rule: a bin is summarized iff the paper reports its coefficient, open endpoint bins included (Figure 3 plots the aggregated -8 and 8 categories).

data_provenance: real (anonymized: README says identifiers and some variables were modified to protect proprietary information while preserving consistency; not synthetic; the shipped data reproduce the authors' logs exactly)
replication_status: exact (vs authors' log; published figure values not available to compare)
notes: CONTROLS ANALYSIS (PROTOCOL 5c). Weekly event study of offline restaurant visits (dine-out transactions): reghdfe dineout t_dummy t_6..t_1 t0..t7 tdummy + seven category counts, absorb(week newid) vce(cluster newid) on Data/Figure2and3_dataset.dta (balanced, 2,162 users x 57 weeks). Only violation: the seven time-varying controls. g_week = week minus the authors' relative week (constant within user; post = 1{rel >= 0} exactly); 27 weekly adoption cohorts (weeks 31-57), 50 percent never-treated, no always-treated. event_pre_min = -7 and event_post_max = 7 reproduce the authors' endpoint bins (<= -8, >= 8). DEVIATION: the authors omit rel = -7, run_spec omits rel = -1; same partition of event time, so the run_spec TWFE post average (rel 0..7) equals the authors' path re-centred on rel = -1 (authors_code implied_post_avg). The >= 8 bin is estimated but not averaged. NOV 2 AUDIT (event_structure): event_structure records the authors' bins (<= -8, -6..-1, 0..7, >= 8) and reference rel = -7; the earlier re-normalization to rel = -1 (implied_post_avg_ref_m1_rel0_7 in authors_code) is superseded. published_coef filled with the post average in the authors' normalization.
